item.description:
The 2025 APEC Music Festa aims to wish a successful opening of the APEC summit and also spread the diversity of the Korean culture witnessed by the recent surge of K-content and K-culture across the globe, according to the concert organizers.

The 2025 APEC Music Festa stage was decorated with a mix of tradition, a staple of the city, with modern culture iconic of the K-pop genre. The festivity features hands-on activities for people to get acquainted with the Silla Dynasty (57 B.C.-A.D. 935), as the city served as the capital for the dynasty's millennium.

2025 APEC Music Festa took place on:
Dates: Friday, 10 October 2025
Location: Gyeongju Civic Stadium, North Gyeongsang city of Gyeongju
Focus: To celebrate the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit set to take place at the end of the month.

Live Stream Date: 10 October 2025 [KBS KPOP YouTube Channel]
Rebroadcast Date: 21 October 2025 [KBS 2TV and KBS World]

Artist Line Up:
NCT Wish, Billlie, izna, KickFlip, Hearts2Hearts, Uspeer, ONF, Oneus, WEi, H1-KEY and singers Yena, Ha Sung-woon and Jung Dae-hyun
